free_text_notes.physician_note: 57-year-old man with obesity, hypertension, admitted 6/1 for elective right total knee arthroplasty. Post-op day 6; tolerating diet, voiding. Needs orthopedic surgery clinic follow-up within 14 days of discharge. The patient reported mild nausea on the morning of day 2. This was managed with a standard anti-nausea medication and the patient has been eating and drinking normally since.
